svg.aria-label: Selected-dataset recovery for all six parameters
svg.title: Selected-dataset recovery for all six parameters
svg.desc: Every neural case and every ready joint-MCMC case is plotted with its central 90% credible interval. No generating parameter was fixed during reference inference.
